selection_rule: Rank by SHA256(rank_prefix + original context SHA256), breaking ties by physical line. Exclude previously manifested rows and ledger-seen test rows, and normalized sentences from all reserved rows, all ledger-seen test rows, and the full train and validation files. Greedily accept batches with four distinct normalized sentences absent from earlier accepted batches. Freeze the first 64. Sentence normalization is NFKC and collapsed whitespace.
